levels.json.source: CadEditor-verified tables; layout offsets in records

levels.bytes.source: binary mirror of levels.json for engine loading

anims.json.source: PRG bank 5 pointer tables; 3 ram_dynamic frames excluded from static decode

anims.bytes.source: binary mirror of anims.json for engine loading

audio_bank3.bytes.source: PRG bank 3 raw (audio driver data: sound table $8A43, note/period tables, song+SFX streams)

world_bank7.bytes.source: PRG bank 7 raw (fixed bank: world descriptor tables $DF50+, engine glue data)

map_nametable.bytes.source: city-map screen nametable captured from live VRAM (probe_map frame 30; static bg = ui_map stream 1 + dialog text)

object_types.bytes.source: bank4 $8AB3 (105x4: flags,behavior,anim,param) + $8C57 (105 HP); verified vs manifest placed_type_ids

prg_bank0.bytes.source: PRG bank 0 raw (room blocks 64B at (cell-1)*64 for worlds with set_bank<6; verified decoder decode_room.py 960/960)

prg_bank1.bytes.source: PRG bank 1 raw (room blocks for set_bank>=6 / FOWL)

prg_bank5.bytes.source: PRG bank 5 raw (anim tables $B429/$B4F0, frame tables $9B0B/$9C45 + $9C0B/$9D45, coord pointers $AE53/$AF23)

prg_bank6.bytes.source: PRG bank 6 raw (enemy behavior dispatch $8000, tables $825F/$82A7, behaviors $82F0+)

notes: Metatile attribute: palette=raw&3, surface type=raw>>4 (0 bg,1 hook,2 platform,3 block,4 spikes,5 door — semantics from editor config, verify per-tile)
Level set index != mission order; mission descriptors live in PRG bank 7 ($DF50/$DF60 per flow research)
